centre.reprime_invitation: Today, the center you are working is your instinct of assertion: taking up space, voicing your desire, acting for yourself. You exist — it's time that it shows.

dynamique_ego.passion_explication: Not a laziness about work. A laziness about self: not feeling oneself, not naming oneself, not waking up to what one truly wants. Comfort as avoidance of the urgency of existing.
dynamique_ego.fixation: Self-forgetting, fusion with what is comfortable
dynamique_ego.compulsion_evitement: Avoiding conflict, separation, loss of harmony.
dynamique_ego.peur_de_base: Being in conflict, separated, losing connection.

essence.qualite_principale: Living Love (that includes without erasing itself)
essence.qualite_phrase: You don't have to disappear to make peace — your presence IS peace.
horizons: Naming yourself, claiming yourself, tending to yourself
Feeling your own desire — and following it
Recognizing conflict as alive, not as rupture
Touching the unity that doesn't erase difference

intentions_du_matin: Feel what I truly want, today
Take up a place — verbal, physical, symbolic
Do something that matters to me — not something 'useful'
Not merge into what the other wants
Start something instead of postponing it
Feel my body — not to move, to exist
Make a clear-cut choice, without diluting it
Honor an anger that wants to rise
pratiques_du_matin: Before noon, feel what you truly feel like eating and eat it.
When someone asks your opinion, take 3 seconds and say the truth — not the diplomatic answer.
Start something you've postponed. Small, but started.
Feel a tension in the body. Let it be there. Tell it: 'you are welcome.'
Choose a place where you will take up space today. Go there.
Before saying yes by reflex, ask yourself: do I want to?

zones.description: Awakened presence. You are there — fully, distinctly. Your peace doesn't erase your desire. Your love doesn't erase your 'I'.
You hold steady. You see escape through comfort when it comes. You can choose to name yourself, sometimes.
Self-forgetting leads. You postpone. You dissolve into what is soft. You avoid through comfort. The 'I' becomes blurred.
Total numbness, dissociation, dazedness. Contact is lost. A very heavy day that calls for a gentle, grounded, bodily awakening.

details_riso.texte: Present, unified, awakened. Your peace is active, full. You include without erasing yourself.
Soothing, patient, welcoming. You see others as equals.
Supportive, mediating, reconciling. Harmony felt, not manufactured.
Amiable, accommodating. You begin to merge. The 'I' politely fades.
Avoidant, passive, procrastinating. You forget yourself. Routine covers feeling.
Resigned, numbed, stubborn. You resist through inertia instead of acting.
Neglect, dissociation, disconnection. You are no longer there in your own life.
Complete erasure, dazedness, depression. You float.
Disintegration, fugue, total self-abandonment. Asking for help is vital here.

passions.label: I merged into what the other wanted
I avoided a conflict worth having
passions.detail: Peace at the cost of myself.

passions.label: I numbed myself — TV, eating, screen
I forgot what I wanted
passions.detail: For the sake of the collective.

passions.label: I stayed in my comfort zone
passions.detail: Even when it no longer nourished me.

pieges.label: I said yes by reflex
pieges.detail: Without knowing if I wanted to.

pieges.label: I gave a diplomatic opinion instead of the true one
I let an emotion that wanted to rise pass by
I was slow, so as not to have to choose
I filled the silence out of habit
pieges.detail: The absence of self as noise.

moments.label: I felt what I truly wanted
I honored an anger that wanted to rise
I was fully present, without erasing myself
True love came — that doesn't erase the 'I'

remedes.label: My true place — taking it, without apologizing
Love that distinguishes — instead of merging

matin: Morning begins. What do YOU want, today?
A day opens up — what place do you want to take in it?
What desire deserves your attention, not your postponement?
midi: You are in the middle of the day. Are you truly there?
Here you are. Have you felt your own voice today?
A possible pause. Feel your body, not the routine.
soir: The day is fading. Have you inhabited yourself a little?
You can simply arrive, present to yourself.
Evening is gentle. An 'I want', that's very good.
nuit: Night keeps watch. Something wanted, then sleep.
You are still here, distinct. And that is very beautiful.
